name: Project Week: AI for Strategic Business Innovation
description:
Projekt week: AI for Strategic Business Innovation is a 12-ECTS seminar offering specialized, intensive training for students to identify both opportunities and challenges in applying AI solutions within organizational contexts.
The seminar can be separated into two blocks: Part 1) Theoretical Foundation and Student Presentations and Part 2) Hackathon during TUM Project Week.
By the end of the seminar, the students will be equipped with theoretical knowledge (including: a) the technical fundamentals of AI, b) economic and business implications of AI across industries and functions, c) an in-depth understanding of potential obstacles in implementing AI in organizations) and practical skills necessary to strategically leverage AI for innovation.
